citations.assessment: The Rav Yosef and Rav Gaza remarks are adjacent. Rav Gaza recounts his own visit and Babylonian kutach in this source.
Both authorities say that Gaza gave them a report. Ravina names Rabbi Yose bar Avin, while Rav Sheshet expressly substitutes Rabbi Yose bar Rabbi Zevida. The opposed rulings differ too.
This passage names Tachlifa bar Gaza, while Avodah Zarah has the Giza spelling.
